title: Editing a running bash script changes the run

found.by: zerobus-debezium-test matrix.sh, edited during a run

symptom: syntax error near unexpected token at the end of a matrix whose runs had all finished
cause: bash reads a script from the file as it runs, so an edit shifts what it reads next
effect: A run fails or does something neither version says
fix: Run from a copy: matrix.sh re-executes itself from a temp file, and each run gets its own copy of the skills
